chapter: Bud Scott band instrumentation and repertoire
title: The early six-piece string band with Bud
summary: The band had two guitars, mandolins, violin and voice, six players; McAllister was with Bud for forty-three years.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: What instruments did you have when they had that high water?

Just the guitar, just the playing string guitar. Not the, just the playing the old six strings. No, I'm talking a band is what I mean. Well, we had, uh, two guitars and voice. Three malons and a, two malons and a violin. Six of us, I think. Yeah, just six. Was that violin? Two guitars, yes, that was both. I started with him.
You started with him, huh? How many years were you with him?
